# Debrief: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus

These clips cover how Prometheus and the OpenTelemetry Collector fit together, including Prometheus receiver and OTLP ingestion changes, span-derived metrics, gateway architecture, and tail sampling tradeoffs. ([OpenTelemetry Collector SIG: Project Updates · 8:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zwLl8QGOdM&t=535s); [Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s); [Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s); [OpenTelemetry Gateways: Enforce, Transform, Route · 4:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S6z2gd666qg&t=256s); [Retroactive Sampling with OpenTelemetry: Cut 90% Distributed Tracing Bandwidth Usage · 7:33](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ehKzt_kGEeM&t=453s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. The Collector's Prometheus receiver does not set start time, so include the start time processor. There is also now a Prometheus remote write receiver, and OTTL and the transform processor reached beta. ([OpenTelemetry Collector SIG: Project Updates · 8:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zwLl8QGOdM&t=535s))
2. Prometheus native histograms are stable. Since 3.9 you must enable them per scrape config, and the OTLP receive endpoint gained early delta ingestion. Exporters and Kubernetes still need to expose native histograms. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s))
3. One team replaced a Prometheus scrape-and-pull setup with Collector pipelines, reusing Prometheus metrics via the Prometheus receiver and its Kubernetes service discovery config, moving off kube-prometheus CRDs. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=788s))

## Action items

- [ ] If you use the Prometheus receiver in the Collector, add the start time processor to your pipeline, since the receiver does not set start time itself. ([OpenTelemetry Collector SIG: Project Updates · 8:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zwLl8QGOdM&t=535s))
- [ ] Check your Prometheus version and enable native histograms at the scrape level, if you are on 3.9 or later, to ingest them. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s))
- [ ] Try Jaeger's monitor tab: enable it, point it at your Prometheus, and view latency, error rate and request rate derived from spans. ([Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s))

## Watch together (12 min)

1. [OpenTelemetry Collector SIG: Project Updates · 8:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zwLl8QGOdM&t=535s) (1:19), Jade G, Dmitrii A, Alex B, Evan B, Antoine T: Concrete Collector changes affecting Prometheus receiver, remote write and OTTL users.
2. [Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s) (2:27), Jan Fajerski, Bartłomiej Płotka: Native histograms and OTLP delta ingestion directly affect Prometheus setup.
3. [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=788s) (3:27), Yash Sharma, Kunju Perath: Real migration from Prometheus scraping to Collector using Prometheus receiver.
4. [Jaeger V2: The Maintainers' Guide To OpenTelemetry-Native Tracing · 13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gH_JzIXFshI&t=782s) (3:44), Pavol Loffay: Shows span-derived metrics flowing into Prometheus via OTLP or remote write.
5. [OpenTelemetry Gateways: Enforce, Transform, Route · 4:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S6z2gd666qg&t=256s) (1:19), Juraci Paixão Kröhling, Natalie Ujuk: Gateway pattern for enforcing policy and routing telemetry across Collectors.
